_comment: Captions for gaps in the register timeline. A run of calendar years with no posts is collapsed into a single break rather than scrolling through empty months. Key by the year, or by 'first-last' for a run. Keep them short: they show as a caption under the break and in the hover tooltip. Ken's copy, so edit freely; delete a key and the break falls back to a plain 'no posts' note.
2022-2024: Three years off; too busy with other things.
